case_number: 2024 INSC 1010; Criminal Appeal No.3175 of 2024 (@ SLP (Crl.) No. 10262 of 2024)
summary: Discharge denied; disproportionate assets case; absence of Income Tax Returns for wife inconclusive; abetment under PC Act requires active complicity beyond marital relationship; burden of proof remains on prosecution at charge stage; charge under Section 109 IPC set aside due to lack of specific allegations supporting conspiracy or instigation; standard: sufficiency of material to form prima facie case; High Court's discharge upheld.
legal_provisions_cited: Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988 s.13(1)(e), s.13(2)
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 s.239, s.482
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment upholding discharge of respondent affirmed.
